text:
carmen: quick update — pushed a small microbatcher + kv eviction policy tweak to a 10% canary on prod-green at 10:12 UTC. goal: reduce p50/p95 during short, bursty traffic and shave token cost for low-latency tail workloads. :rocket:
jia: nice — high level: what changed? config diff?
carmen: two changes: 1) microbatcher now aggressively coalesces windows under 8 tokens when QPS < 50; 2) kvcache low-water mark moved from 20% -> 8% for hot-prefix paths. small flooring to avoid eager evicts during surge.
mike: did you run bench harness on the short-request mix? numbers pls.
carmen: yep — ran the live-replay bench for 60m against canary nodes and baseline nodes. summary: p50 improved 7ms -> 3ms (55% rel), p95 33ms -> 26ms (~21% rel), p99 210ms -> 170ms (~19% rel) for requests < 32 tokens. cost-per-1M-tokens dropped ~12% vs baseline under same load (mostly from fewer wasted microbatches).
sofia: any regressions on long sequences or heavy KV churn?
carmen: flagged a tiny p99 uptick for >1024 token requests on one shard (210ms->230ms). looks correlated to long-seq scheduling when microbatcher drains; isolated to a node with older kernel image. not widespread.
jia: can you paste the config snippet you rolled? makes it easier for QE to reproduce.
carmen: sure:```json
{"microbatch": {"max_window_tokens": 8, "aggressive_coalesce_qps": 50}, "kvcache": {"low_water_pct": 8}}
```
mike: thanks. ran a short replay on staging with 10x long-seq and saw no meaningful change after bumping kernel on that shard. ops should patch remaining nodes.
sofia: ops-bot: can you post the canary dashboard link and the perf-run id?
ops-bot: canary dashboards: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/canary/1755555555 - perf-run id perf_2026_03_22_1012 - baseline vs canary traces attached. :white_check_mark:
jia: any rollout plan? full flip or staged?
carmen: propose staged region-by-region over 6h with quick rollback flags. steps: 1) finish kernel patch on 3 remaining nodes, 2) expand canary to 30% for 1h, 3) run automated smoke harness, 4) flip to 100% if no regressions. will create a release checklist.
mike: add a quick test for long-seq scheduling to the smoke harness (p99 threshold alert).
sofia: tagging on-call for midnight ops window? @mike @jia are you ok with 23:00 UTC window?
mike: ok for me. jia: yes.
jia: also adding a short note to changelog and the perf playbook so SRE knows the new low_water_pct semantics.
carmen: thanks team. TL;DR: small config tweaks -> large p50/p95 improvements for short requests, ~12% token cost reduction in replay, minor long-seq tail bump on an old kernel that we patched; staged rollout planned tonight. will post the final postmortem + perf artifacts after full rollout. :tada:
